# Driving Emotions

> Exotic and luxury car dealer in Lake Park (Palm Beach area), Florida.

Concept note: part of an unofficial Kerblabs design concept. Facts come from drivingemotions.com. Confirm details and live inventory with the business.

## Services
- Exotic and luxury car sales
- Vehicle consignment
- Financing options
- Car locator service
- Vehicle shipping
- Marques listed on their site: Aston Martin, Bentley, Bugatti, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Rolls-Royce, McLaren
- Tuning partners listed: RENNtech, Kleeman, Carlsson, Champion, WeisTec

## Location
- 848 12th Street, Suite 102, Lake Park, FL 33403

## Actions
Plain-language actions an assistant can offer the buyer. At launch each one is wired to the business's real booking or quote channel.
- Ask about a specific car: send the marque and model
- Consign a car: send the vehicle details
- Request a car search: describe the car you want located
- Request a shipping quote

## Official site
- https://www.drivingemotions.com
